text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan sprinted through. ...With a 
speed so absurdly incredible, it felt like 
a dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Listening to everyone's praise, Tosen 
Jordan smiles satisfied. She then readied 
her smartphone and pointed the camera at 
her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Your trainee Umamusume won the race— how 
are you feeling right now?" ...She asks, 
almost like an interviewer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then, she turned the camera back 
toward herself. This time, she proclaimed 
that her Trainer was also the strongest, 
accompanied by a radiant smile.
